cost.local: USD 35 FCC application fee, plus USD 15 for an ARRL volunteer-examiner session.
cost.en: USD 35 FCC application fee, plus USD 15 for an ARRL volunteer-examiner session.

process.local: Register for an FCC FRN, pass a volunteer-examiner test, pay the FCC application fee, then wait for your call sign in the FCC database before transmitting.
process.en: Register for an FCC FRN, pass a volunteer-examiner test, pay the FCC application fee, then wait for your call sign in the FCC database before transmitting.

cost.local: The Foundation exam costs GBP 35.50. The Ofcom licence is free online or GBP 20 by paper application; training may cost extra.
cost.en: The Foundation exam costs GBP 35.50. The Ofcom licence is free online or GBP 20 by paper application; training may cost extra.

process.local: Pass the RSGB Foundation exam, then use your pass details to apply for an amateur radio licence and call sign through Ofcom's online portal.
process.en: Pass the RSGB Foundation exam, then use your pass details to apply for an amateur radio licence and call sign through Ofcom's online portal.

cost.local: 150 zł za egzamin i 82 zł za pozwolenie, razem 232 zł dla dorosłego; egzamin osoby poniżej 18 lat kosztuje 75 zł.
cost.en: PLN 150 for the exam and PLN 82 for the permit, totaling PLN 232 for an adult; the exam costs PLN 75 for someone under 18.

time.local: Do 6 tygodni od złożenia kompletnego wniosku o pozwolenie; oczekiwanie na termin egzaminu jest osobne.
time.en: Up to 6 weeks from a complete permit application; waiting for an exam slot is separate.

requirements.local: Od 1 maja 2026 r. egzamin jest pisemnym testem; zapis najpóźniej 7 dni przed terminem. Po zdaniu złóż wniosek o pozwolenie do UKE.
requirements.en: Since 1 May 2026 the exam is a written test; register no later than 7 days before it. After passing, apply to UKE for the permit.

process.local: Zapisz się na egzamin UKE, zdaj test pisemny, a następnie złóż wniosek o pozwolenie radiowe ze znakiem wywoławczym i dowodem wniesienia opłaty.
process.en: Register for the UKE exam, pass the written test, then apply for the radio permit with a call sign and proof of fee payment.

authority.name: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada (ISED)

cost.local: ISED charges no fee for the initial operator certificate and call sign; an examiner may charge for the exam.
cost.en: ISED charges no fee for the initial operator certificate and call sign; an examiner may charge for the exam.

time.local: Accredited examiners must submit results within 10 working days; ISED's issuance time is not specified here.
time.en: Accredited examiners must submit results within 10 working days; ISED's issuance time is not specified here.

process.local: Pass the Basic Qualification exam with at least 70%, using an ISED-accredited examiner. After receiving the examiner's authorization key, create your account and select an available call sign.
process.en: Pass the Basic Qualification exam with at least 70%, using an ISED-accredited examiner. After receiving the examiner's authorization key, create your account and select an available call sign.

time.local: L'ANFR envoie le certificat dans un délai d'environ trois semaines après la réussite de l'examen; la demande d'indicatif suit.
time.en: ANFR sends the certificate about three weeks after passing the exam; the call-sign application follows.

requirements.local: Réussir les épreuves de réglementation et de technique, puis demander un indicatif.
requirements.en: Pass the regulation and technical exams, then apply for a call sign.

process.local: Prenez rendez-vous avec un centre d'examen de l'ANFR, réussissez les épreuves de réglementation et de technique, puis demandez un indicatif après réception du certificat.
process.en: Book with an ANFR exam centre, pass the regulation and technical tests, then request a call sign after receiving the certificate.

cost.local: L'examen est gratuit depuis 2021 et la taxe annuelle de licence a été supprimée en 2019; une formation facultative peut coûter davantage.
cost.en: The exam has been free since 2021 and the annual licence tax was abolished in 2019; optional training may cost extra.

authority.name: Ministero delle Imprese e del Made in Italy (MIMIT)

cost.local: Per l'esame e il certificato: €25 più due marche da bollo da €16 secondo il tariffario ministeriale 2025; verificare eventuali costi successivi dell'autorizzazione.
cost.en: For the exam and certificate: EUR 25 plus two EUR 16 stamp duties under the ministry's 2025 schedule; check any later authorization costs.

cost.local: USD 35 por la solicitud ante la FCC y USD 15 por una sesión de examen de los examinadores voluntarios de ARRL.
cost.en: USD 35 FCC application fee and USD 15 for an ARRL volunteer-examiner session.

requirements.local: Puerto Rico sigue el sistema de licencias de radioaficionado de la FCC de Estados Unidos.
requirements.en: Puerto Rico follows the US FCC amateur licensing system.

process.local: Obtén un número FRN de la FCC, aprueba un examen con examinadores voluntarios, paga la solicitud de la FCC y espera el indicativo antes de transmitir.
process.en: Obtain an FCC FRN, pass a volunteer-examiner test, pay the FCC application fee, and wait for a call sign before transmitting.

process.local: Подтвердите квалификацию, оформите позывной через ГРЧЦ и зарегистрируйте радиооборудование в Роскомнадзоре до выхода в эфир.
process.en: Establish operator qualification, obtain a call sign through GRFC, and register radio equipment with Roskomnadzor before transmitting.

authority.name: Secretaría de Estado de Telecomunicaciones e Infraestructuras Digitales

time.local: La administración debe resolver y notificar la autorización individual en seis semanas desde la recepción de la solicitud; la espera del examen es aparte.
time.en: The administration must decide and notify the individual authorization within six weeks from receipt of the application; exam scheduling is separate.

process.local: Inscríbete al examen oficial, supera las pruebas de normativa y técnica y solicita después la autorización individual y el distintivo de llamada.
process.en: Register for the official exam, pass regulation and technical tests, then apply for individual authorization and a call sign.

cost.local: El examen cuesta €23,67 y la autorización individual €114,36; el total ordinario es €138,03, sin formación opcional.
cost.en: Exam EUR 23.67 plus individual authorization EUR 114.36, totaling EUR 138.03 for the ordinary route, excluding optional training.

cost.local: Prüfung: Klasse N €68, E €73,50 oder A €81; Zuteilung eines persönlichen Rufzeichens zusätzlich €20.
cost.en: Exam: class N EUR 68, E EUR 73.50 or A EUR 81; personal call-sign allocation adds EUR 20.

time.local: Prüfungstermine finden normalerweise alle vier bis sechs Wochen statt; die Bearbeitung der anschließenden Rufzeichenzuteilung ist gesondert.
time.en: Exams are normally held every four to six weeks; subsequent call-sign allocation is separate.

requirements.local: Minderjährige benötigen die Zustimmung der Erziehungsberechtigten.
requirements.en: Minors need their guardian's consent.

requirements.local: Lulus Ujian Negara Amatir Radio (UNAR), memperoleh izin, lalu menjadi anggota ORARI dalam 30 hari kerja setelah izin diterbitkan.
requirements.en: Pass the state amateur exam (UNAR), obtain the permit, then join ORARI within 30 working days after permit issue.

cost.local: Registratie in 2026: €56 online of €76 op papier; daarnaast geldt een jaarlijkse registratievergoeding.
cost.en: 2026 registration: EUR 56 online or EUR 76 on paper; an annual registration charge also applies.

authority.name: 工业和信息化部及地方无线电管理机构

society.name: 中国无线电协会业余无线电分会 (CRAC)

sources.name: 南京设台许可办事指南

process.local: 先通过 A、B 或 C 类操作技术能力验证，再向省级无线电管理机构提交设台申请；部分高功率短波电台由国家机构办理。
process.en: Pass the A, B or C operator competence test, then apply to the provincial radio authority for a station licence; some high-power HF stations go to the national authority.

cost.local: 操作技术能力验证免费，业余频率不收占用费；地方办事指南列明设台许可免费。
cost.en: Operator competence testing is free and there is no amateur-frequency occupancy fee; a local government guide states station licensing is free.

time.local: 2024 年规定要求受理后 30 个工作日内作出许可决定；技术检测和频率协调时间另计。
time.en: The 2024 rule requires a licensing decision within 30 working days after acceptance; technical testing and frequency coordination are excluded.

requirements.local: 须提交申请表、身份证明及发射设备型号、序列号和照片；自制设备需说明情况。
requirements.en: Submit the application, identity document and transmitter model, serial number and photos; self-built equipment needs an explanation.

society.name: Liga de Amadores Brasileiros de Rádio Emissão (LABRE)

cost.local: A qualificação COER é gratuita; a estação própria pode gerar taxas de autorização, direito de uso de frequência e fiscalização. Confira o cálculo oficial antes de solicitar.
cost.en: The COER operator qualification is free; operating a personal station may add authorization, frequency-right and annual inspection charges. Check the official calculation before applying.

requirements.local: El antiguo sitio del IFT es un archivo; confirma el trámite vigente con la CRT antes de solicitar la concesión.
requirements.en: The former IFT site is an archive; confirm the current concession process with the CRT before applying.

authority.name: Υπηρεσίες Μεταφορών και Επικοινωνιών / κρατική πύλη ραδιοερασιτεχνών

cost.local: Το παράβολο εξέτασης είναι €26 και το παράβολο άδειας σταθμού €26, συνολικά €52 για την τυπική διαδρομή.
cost.en: The exam fee is EUR 26 and the station licence fee EUR 26, totaling EUR 52 for the ordinary route.

requirements.local: Για την εξέταση απαιτούνται έγγραφο ταυτότητας, δύο έγχρωμες φωτογραφίες και συναίνεση κηδεμόνα για ανηλίκους· μετά την επιτυχία ζητήστε πτυχίο και άδεια σταθμού.
requirements.en: Exam applicants need an identity document, two colour photos and guardian consent for minors; after passing, request the diploma and station licence.

process.local: Υποβάλετε αίτηση εξέτασης στην αρμόδια περιφερειακή υπηρεσία, επιτύχετε στις εξετάσεις, παραλάβετε πτυχίο και ζητήστε άδεια σταθμού με το διακριτικό σας.
process.en: Apply for the exam at the regional service, pass, obtain the diploma, and request a station licence and call sign.

requirements.local: The published NTC rules call for an examination result, station paperwork and membership in an accredited club affiliated with PARA; check the current regional procedure.
requirements.en: The published NTC rules call for an examination result, station paperwork and membership in an accredited club affiliated with PARA; check the current regional procedure.

cost.local: La categoría Aspirante es gratuita; Novicio, General y Superior cuestan 0,3 UTM según SUBTEL.
cost.en: Aspirante class is free; Novicio, General and Superior cost 0.3 UTM according to SUBTEL.

time.local: SUBTEL programa exámenes mensualmente en 2026; el plazo de expedición posterior no está publicado aquí.
time.en: SUBTEL schedules exams monthly in 2026; the later issuance period is not stated here.

cost.local: Pätevyystutkinto maksaa €60; radioaseman lupa ja vuosittainen taajuusmaksu ovat erillisiä.
cost.en: The qualification exam costs EUR 60; the station licence and annual frequency fee are separate.

time.local: Sähköisen asioinnin kautta haettu lupa voi tulla voimaan heti hyväksymisen jälkeen; tutkintoon pääsy riippuu järjestetystä ajankohdasta.
time.en: An e-service licence can take effect immediately after approval; exam scheduling is separate.

cost.local: ACMA charges AUD 48 for recognition of qualifications and AUD 32 for a next-available call sign; exam providers may charge separately.
cost.en: ACMA charges AUD 48 for recognition of qualifications and AUD 32 for a next-available call sign; exam providers may charge separately.

authority.name: Agencia de Regulación y Control de las Telecomunicaciones (ARCOTEL)

cost.local: USD 5 para categoría Técnico o USD 10 para General; no se exige afiliación a un radioclub.
cost.en: USD 5 for Técnico or USD 10 for General; radio-club membership is not required.

time.local: Aproximadamente 7 días laborables, según ARCOTEL.
time.en: About 7 working days, according to ARCOTEL.

requirements.local: Se requieren identificación y solicitud; los menores necesitan autorización notariada de su representante.
requirements.en: Identity documents and application are required; minors need notarized guardian authorization.

cost.local: El trámite de primera licencia ante ENACOM es gratuito; consulta al radioclub los costos de preparación o examen.
cost.en: The first-licence procedure at ENACOM is free; ask the radio club about preparation or exam costs.

requirements.local: Presentar DNI, CUIL, certificado de antecedentes penales y constancias de práctica y examen de un radioclub autorizado; edad mínima: 9 años.
requirements.en: Provide DNI, CUIL, criminal-record certificate and practice/exam records from an authorized radio club; minimum age 9.

authority.name: Belgisch Instituut voor postdiensten en telecommunicatie (BIPT)

society.name: Koninklijke Unie van de Belgische Zendamateurs (UBA)

cost.local: Het bedieningscertificaat kost in 2026 €31,65; de eerste afgifte is inbegrepen in het examengeld. Voor een eigen station kan een afzonderlijke vergunning nodig zijn.
cost.en: The 2026 operator certificate costs EUR 31.65; first issue is included in the exam fee. A separate authorization may be needed for a personal station.

time.local: BIPT organiseert minstens maandelijks examens; de afgiftetermijn is hier niet vermeld.
time.en: BIPT holds exams at least monthly; issuance time is not stated here.

authority.name: Ministerio de Tecnologías de la Información y las Comunicaciones (MinTIC)

cost.local: La solicitud no tiene costo, pero la autorización exige una contraprestación; consulta el valor vigente en la tabla de MinTIC.
cost.en: The application has no fee, but authorization requires a contribution; check MinTIC's current fee table.

time.local: MinTIC programa exámenes el primer y tercer viernes de cada mes; el tiempo posterior de autorización no se indica aquí.
time.en: MinTIC schedules exams on the first and third Friday of each month; later authorization time is not stated here.

cost.local: Zkouška a průkaz odborné způsobilosti stojí 600 Kč; následné individuální oprávnění stojí 400 Kč elektronicky nebo 500 Kč papírově.
cost.en: Exam and competence card cost CZK 600; the subsequent individual authorization costs CZK 400 online or CZK 500 on paper.

cost.local: Prüfung €71 einschließlich Antrag; Zeugnis weitere €21. Eine gesonderte Stationsbewilligung kann Gebühren verursachen.
cost.en: Exam EUR 71 including application; certificate adds EUR 21. A separate station permit may incur fees.

requirements.local: Mindestalter 14 Jahre; nach der Prüfung ist eine gesonderte Stationsbewilligung erforderlich.
requirements.en: Minimum age 14; a separate station permit is required after the exam.

cost.local: Таксите за 2026 г. са €10 за изпит и €4 за удостоверение; електронно подаване: €8 и €3.
cost.en: 2026 fees are EUR 10 for the exam and EUR 4 for the certificate; online filing costs EUR 8 and EUR 3.

cost.local: Prøven koster 623 kr., og kaldesignalet koster 440 kr. ifølge styrelsen.
cost.en: The exam costs DKK 623 and the call sign costs DKK 440 according to the agency.

time.local: Bevis og kaldesignal udstedes normalt inden for 15 arbejdsdage efter godkendt prøve og ansøgning.
time.en: Certificate and call sign are normally issued within 15 working days after the passed exam and application.

cost.local: Written exam SGD 40 (SGD 20 for full-time students); five-year station licence SGD 100 general or SGD 50 restricted.
cost.en: Written exam SGD 40 (SGD 20 for full-time students); five-year station licence SGD 100 general or SGD 50 restricted.

time.local: SARTS arranges the examination on IMDA's behalf quarterly; the licence processing time is not stated here.
time.en: SARTS arranges the examination on IMDA's behalf quarterly; the licence processing time is not stated here.

requirements.local: Vanlig amatörradio kräver giltigt certifikat och anropssignal, men inget separat PTS-tillstånd; hög effekt kräver särskilt tillstånd. SSA hanterar prov och anropssignaler.
requirements.en: Ordinary amateur operation needs a valid certificate and call sign but no separate PTS licence; high power needs a special permit. SSA handles exams and call signs.

process.local: Anmäl dig till prov via SSA, klara provet och få certifikat och anropssignal från SSA före sändning.
process.en: Register for an exam through SSA, pass it, and obtain an SSA certificate and call sign before transmitting.

authority.name: สำนักงาน กสทช. (NBTC)

society.name: สมาคมวิทยุสมัครเล่นแห่งประเทศไทยในพระบรมราชูปถัมภ์ (RAST)

cost.local: ค่าธรรมเนียมใบอนุญาตผู้ปฏิบัติการ 200 บาท ตามข้อมูล กสทช.; ตรวจสอบค่าธรรมเนียมการสอบและสถานีแยกต่างหาก
cost.en: Operator licence fee THB 200 according to NBTC; check exam and station charges separately.

sources.name: KEGM amatör telsizcilik sık sorulan sorular

cost.local: KEGM'nin 2026 tarifesinde sınav 1.022 TL ve belge 1.276 TL'dir; standart toplam 2.298 TL. Öğrenci veya engelli aday için sınav 510 TL, belge 638 TL'dir. MEB e-sınav ücreti ayrı belirlenir.
cost.en: KEGM's 2026 tariff lists TRY 1,022 for the exam and TRY 1,276 for the certificate, totaling TRY 2,298 on the standard route. Student or disabled applicants pay TRY 510 and TRY 638. The MEB electronic exam is priced separately.

authority.name: سازمان تنظیم مقررات و ارتباطات رادیویی (CRA)

society.name: No current national society verified — IARU directory
society.localName: انجمن ملی فعال تأیید نشد — فهرست IARU

cost.local: A new licence costs EUR 100, or EUR 30 for eligible older or allowance recipients; examination fees may be separate.
cost.en: A new licence costs EUR 100, or EUR 30 for eligible older or allowance recipients; examination fees may be separate.

authority.name: Hrvatska regulatorna agencija za mrežne djelatnosti (HAKOM)

requirements.local: Položite ispit A ili P, pribavite prijedlog pozivne oznake od HRS-a i podnesite HAKOM-u zahtjev s podacima o opremi.
requirements.en: Pass the A or P exam, obtain an HRS call-sign proposal, and apply to HAKOM with equipment details.

authority.name: Autoritatea Națională pentru Administrare și Reglementare în Comunicații (ANCOM)

requirements.local: Înscrierea la examenul ANCOM necesită cerere și act de identitate; verifică sesiunea publicată de autoritate.
requirements.en: ANCOM exam registration requires an application and identity document; check the authority's published session.

authority.name: Регулаторно тело за електронске комуникације и поштанске услуге (РАТЕЛ)

cost.local: Према тарифнику за 2026. накнада за радиоаматерску станицу је 1.389 RSD; проверите засебне трошкове испита.
cost.en: Under the 2026 schedule, the amateur station fee is RSD 1,389; check separate exam costs.

requirements.local: Поднесите доказ о положеном испиту, потврду о уплати и захтев за лиценцу; лиценца важи 10 година.
requirements.en: Submit proof of passing the exam, fee receipt and licence application; the licence is valid for 10 years.

authority.name: Agencija za komunikacijska omrežja in storitve (AKOS)

requirements.local: Po izpitu, ki ga organizira ZRS, zaprosite AKOS za radijsko dovoljenje.
requirements.en: After an exam organized by ZRS, apply to AKOS for the radio permit.

time.local: 장비가 승인된 경우 무선국 허가 처리 기간은 7일, 미승인 장비는 14일로 안내됩니다. 자격시험 일정은 별도입니다.
time.en: Station permit processing is listed as 7 days for approved equipment or 14 days for unapproved equipment; exam scheduling is separate.

society.name: 日本アマチュア無線連盟 (JARL)

cost.local: 第4級国家試験は2026年9月30日まで5,100円、10月1日から5,700円です。従事者免許と無線局開設には別途手数料がかかります。
cost.en: The class 4 national exam costs JPY 5,100 through 30 September 2026 and JPY 5,700 from 1 October. Operator credential and station opening carry separate fees.

process.local: 国家試験などで無線従事者資格を取得し、従事者免許を申請した後、総務省の電子申請でアマチュア局の開設免許を申請します。
process.en: Obtain an operator qualification through the national exam or another accepted route, apply for the operator credential, then use the MIC electronic portal to apply for the amateur station licence.

cost.local: La autorización de categoría Novicio es gratuita según el MTC.
cost.en: Novicio authorization is free according to MTC.

time.local: El MTC indica una respuesta en 21 días hábiles para este trámite.
time.en: MTC states a response within 21 business days for this procedure.

requirements.local: Presenta la solicitud, el certificado de examen o pide que el MTC programe el examen, y la ficha de equipos; la autorización dura cinco años.
requirements.en: Submit the application, exam certificate or request an MTC exam, and equipment form; the authorization lasts five years.

time.local: A decisão sobre transferência de certificado HAREC é comunicada em até 10 dias; o prazo de uma primeira licença pode ser diferente.
time.en: A HAREC certificate transfer decision is communicated within 10 days; a first licence may take a different time.

requirements.local: O exame e o certificado são exigidos; a idade mínima é 12 anos e os menores precisam de autorização dos responsáveis.
requirements.en: Exam and certificate are required; minimum age is 12 and minors need guardian permission.

authority.name: Національна комісія з регулювання електронних комунікацій / УДЦР

sources.name: Guía de trámites de radioaficionados de CONATEL

society.name: Asocijacija radioamatera u Bosni i Hercegovini (ARAuBiH)

authority.name: និយ័តករទូរគមនាគមន៍កម្ពុជា (TRC)

society.name: Cambodian Amateur Radio Group (CAMRG) — club reference
society.localName: ក្រុមវិទ្យុស្ម័គ្រចិត្តកម្ពុជា (CAMRG) — ព័ត៌មានអំពីក្លឹប

cost.local: Ο πίνακας τελών αναφέρει €50 για αίτηση και €30 για λειτουργία ή ανανέωση· επιβεβαιώστε την τρέχουσα χρέωση.
cost.en: The fee table lists EUR 50 for application and EUR 30 for operation or renewal; confirm the current charge.

cost.local: La guía de INDOTEL indica RD$200 para el examen de categoría Novicio; confirma las tasas de la licencia.
cost.en: INDOTEL's guide lists RD$200 for the Novicio exam; confirm licence fees.

authority.name: 通訊事務管理局辦公室 (OFCA)

cost.local: 業餘電台牌照年費為港幣 150 元；考試費用須另行查詢。
cost.en: The amateur station licence is HKD 150 per year; check exam fees separately.

sources.name: OFCA 業餘無線電組織名單

time.local: A sikeres vizsga igazolását az NMHH 30 napon belül postázza; az állomásengedély külön eljárás.
time.en: NMHH mails the successful exam certificate within 30 days; the station permit is a separate procedure.

cost.local: Az NMHH szerint az állomásengedélynek nincs havi díja; az aktuális vizsgadíjat külön ellenőrizze.
cost.en: NMHH says the station permit has no monthly fee; check the current exam charge separately.

cost.local: הבחינה ללא תשלום; רישיון תחנה חדש עולה 105 ש״ח לפי משרד התקשורת.
cost.en: The exam is free; a new station licence costs NIS 105 according to the Ministry of Communications.

requirements.local: יש להגיש מסמכי זהות וטפסים אישיים; רישיון התחנה מחודש אחת לחמש שנים.
requirements.en: Submit identity documents and personal forms; the station licence is renewed every five years.

requirements.local: Omba ukiwa na ushahidi wa mtihani au HAREC, kitambulisho au pasipoti na ada isiyorejeshwa.
requirements.en: Apply with examination or HAREC evidence, ID or passport and a nonrefundable fee.

time.local: Sesiunile de examen sunt organizate, de regulă, trimestrial; înscrierea se face cu cel puțin 15 zile înainte. Durata emiterii nu este indicată.
time.en: Exam sessions are generally quarterly; apply at least 15 days before. Issuance time is not stated.

cost.local: Das BAKOM nennt CHF 110 für die Rufzeichenzuteilung und CHF 50 jährliche Verwaltungsgebühr; die Prüfungsgebühr ist gesondert zu prüfen.
cost.en: OFCOM lists CHF 110 for call-sign allocation and CHF 50 annual administration; check the exam charge separately.

authority.name: Autoriteti i Komunikimeve Elektronike dhe Postare (AKEP)

cost.local: رسوم طلب الترخيص 100 جنيه مصري، إضافة إلى رسم الطيف؛ تحقق من المبلغ الكامل لدى الجهاز.
cost.en: New licence application EGP 100 plus a spectrum fee; check the full amount with NTRA.

time.local: تذكر البوابة 30 يومًا، لكن الموافقات الأمنية المطلوبة ليس لها مدة محددة.
time.en: The portal lists 30 days, but required security approvals have no fixed duration.

requirements.local: يلزم النجاح في الاختبار وتقديم الهوية ومواصفات الجهاز وإثبات الإقامة والمؤهل الدراسي.
requirements.en: Pass the exam and provide ID, equipment specifications, proof of residence and education.

cost.local: TTJA riigilõiv on loa väljastamisel või pikendamisel €10; HAREC tunnistus maksab eraldi €16.
cost.en: TTJA's state fee is EUR 10 for issuing or renewing the permit; a HAREC certificate costs EUR 16 separately.

time.local: TTJA teeb täieliku taotluse kohta otsuse 15 tööpäeva jooksul; luba kehtib viis aastat.
time.en: TTJA decides within 15 working days of a complete application; the permit is valid for five years.

cost.local: 2024 के नियमों में परीक्षा आवेदन शुल्क ₹100 है; स्टेशन लाइसेंस शुल्क अलग से जाँचें।
cost.en: The 2024 rules set the exam application fee at INR 100; check the station licence fee separately.

requirements.local: परीक्षा के लिए कम से कम एक महीने पहले आवेदन करें।
requirements.en: Apply for the exam at least one month in advance.

cost.local: 2026. gada eksāmens maksā €21,59; pamata izsaukuma signāla atļauja maksā €19,20 saskaņā ar iestādes ceļvedi.
cost.en: The 2026 exam costs EUR 21.59; the basic call-sign permit costs EUR 19.20 according to the agency's guide.

time.local: Pareizi aizpildītu pieteikumu izskata viena mēneša laikā.
time.en: A correctly completed application is reviewed within one month.

cost.local: Egzaminas kainuoja €10, o leidimo išdavimas €2,90 pagal RRT skelbiamus įkainius.
cost.en: Exam costs EUR 10 and permit issue EUR 2.90 under RRT's published charges.

cost.local: Peperiksaan RAE RM50, permohonan Apparatus Assignment RM60 dan fi tahunan Kelas C RM12; jumlah rasmi tahun pertama Kelas C ialah RM122, tanpa latihan atau peralatan.
cost.en: RAE exam RM 50, Apparatus Assignment application RM 60 and Class C annual fee RM 12; official Class C first-year total RM 122, excluding training and equipment.

process.local: Beli baucar dan tempah peperiksaan RAE Kelas A, B atau C melalui SEMS MCMC; selepas lulus, dapatkan Apparatus Assignment sebelum memancar.
process.en: Buy a voucher and book the Class A, B or C RAE through MCMC SEMS; after passing, obtain an Apparatus Assignment before transmitting.

cost.local: Nkom oppgir en engangsavgift på 2 170 kr for utstedelse av radioamatørlisens i 2026; spør NRRL om eventuell prøveavgift.
cost.en: Nkom lists a one-time NOK 2,170 licence issue fee in 2026; ask NRRL about any exam charge.

requirements.local: تعليمات 2019 تطلب نموذج الطلب، والهوية أو جواز السفر، ورخصة أجنبية سارية لغير الفلسطينيين، ودفع الرسوم المقررة.
requirements.en: The 2019 rules require an application, ID or passport, a valid foreign licence for non-Palestinians, and payment of prescribed fees.

society.name: Samoa Amateur Radio Club (SARC) — IARU listing

time.local: تشير خدمة إصدار الرخصة إلى الإصدار الفوري بعد استيفاء متطلبات الاختبار؛ يعتمد الوصول إلى الاختبار على موعده.
time.en: The licensing service lists immediate issuance after exam requirements are met; getting an exam slot is separate.

cost.local: رسوم الاختبار الأول 300 ريال سعودي، والإعادة 100 ريال؛ تحقق من رسوم إصدار الرخصة على حدة.
cost.en: First exam fee SAR 300 and repeat exam SAR 100; check the licence issue fee separately.

requirements.local: يجب أن يكون المتقدم مواطنًا سعوديًا أو مقيمًا وأن يجتاز الاختبار قبل طلب الرخصة.
requirements.en: The applicant must be a Saudi citizen or resident and pass the exam before applying for the licence.

authority.name: Úrad pre reguláciu elektronických komunikácií a poštových služieb

cost.local: Skúška a doklad o spôsobilosti stoja €30, individuálne povolenie €5; pri elektronickom podaní platí zľava 50 %. Skontrolujte aj samostatnú úhradu za frekvencie.
cost.en: The exam and competence document cost EUR 30, individual authorization EUR 5, with a 50% online filing discount. Check the separate frequency charge too.

authority.name: Independent Communications Authority of South Africa (ICASA)

cost.local: SARL lists the October 2026 RAE exam at R500 for Class A or R450 for Class B. ICASA's initial licence/application charge is separate and was not verified.
cost.en: SARL lists the October 2026 RAE exam at ZAR 500 for Class A or ZAR 450 for Class B. ICASA's initial licence/application charge is separate and was not verified.

requirements.local: Candidates pass the SARL RAE, then register and submit the certificate and application to ICASA. Class B is the entry-level route for applicants under 25.
requirements.en: Candidates pass the SARL RAE, then register and submit the certificate and application to ICASA. Class B is the entry-level route for applicants under 25.

society.name: 中華民國業餘無線電促進會 (CTARL)

cost.local: 資格測試審查費新臺幣 200 元、人員執照費 500 元、電臺執照費 500 元；依電臺類型另有 100 元或 500 元審驗費。
cost.en: Qualification-test review NT$200, operator licence NT$500 and station licence NT$500; station inspection adds NT$100 or NT$500 depending on station type.

process.local: 先參加 NCC 業餘無線電人員資格測試，取得人員執照，再申請電臺設置、審驗及電臺執照。
process.en: Take the NCC amateur operator qualification test, obtain the operator licence, then apply for station establishment, inspection and station licence.

time.local: تذكر خدمة الهيئة مدة إنجاز تبلغ 12 يومًا بعد تقديم طلب مستوفٍ.
time.en: TDRA lists a 12-day processing period after a complete application.

requirements.local: تطلب الخدمة جواز السفر أو إثبات الإقامة ونسخة من عضوية جمعية الإمارات لهواة اللاسلكي.
requirements.en: The service requests passport or residence evidence and a copy of EARS membership.

cost.local: تحدد لائحة الهيئة رسمًا سنويًا قدره 200 درهم إماراتي؛ تحقق من الرسوم عند تقديم الطلب.
cost.en: TDRA regulations set an annual fee of AED 200; confirm it when applying.

sources.name: Yêu cầu chứng chỉ vô tuyến điện viên

process.local: Chuẩn bị Mẫu 1b và chứng chỉ vô tuyến điện viên, rồi nộp hồ sơ cấp phép đài tại trung tâm phục vụ hành chính công cấp tỉnh.
process.en: Prepare Form 1b and the amateur operator certificate, then submit the station-permit application to the provincial public service centre.

cost.local: Phí cấp giấy phép là 240.000 đồng một lần; phí sử dụng tần số là 240.000 đồng cho mỗi băng trong 12 tháng. Một băng trong năm đầu tối thiểu 480.000 đồng, chưa tính phí thi.
cost.en: One-time issuance fee VND 240,000 plus VND 240,000 per band per 12 months; one band in the first year totals at least VND 480,000 before any exam cost.

time.local: Cơ quan cấp tỉnh giải quyết trong 11 ngày kể từ khi nhận đủ hồ sơ hợp lệ.
time.en: The provincial authority decides within 11 days of receiving a complete valid application.

requirements.local: Cần chứng chỉ vô tuyến điện viên và Mẫu 1b; người nước ngoài có thể nộp bản sao hộ chiếu và xuất trình bản gốc khi nhận kết quả.
requirements.en: An operator certificate and Form 1b are required; foreign applicants may submit a passport copy and present the original when collecting the result.
